scope.summary: Author the bodykit_morph_assets (BMA-) and bodykit_channel_registry (BCH-) migrations per Section 13.16 (BK-16.3): morph assets store sparse delta payload refs, region mask refs, multi-key track metadata (key_pct positions 0/50/100/200/300 per TAI-BK-033), and a MANDATORY license_tag column feeding the MT-488 guard; the channel registry stores durable BodyChannel definitions (kind skeletal|tissue, range with design_max) addressable by stable snake_case channel_key (REQ-043).
acceptance_criteria: Migration creates bodykit_morph_assets (morph_asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY 'BMA-{uuid_v7}', channel_id TEXT, kind TEXT, key_pct INTEGER, delta_payload_ref TEXT NOT NULL, region_mask_ref TEXT NOT NULL, license_tag TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (license_tag <> ''), event_ledger_event_id TEXT NOT NULL).

Migration creates bodykit_channel_registry (channel_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY 'BCH-{uuid_v7}', channel_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('skeletal','tissue')), group_key TEXT NOT NULL, region_mask_ref TEXT NOT NULL, range_json JSONB NOT NULL, default_value REAL NOT NULL, event_ledger_event_id TEXT NOT NULL).

Write path validates channel_key snake_case and range_json shape {min, max, design_max} with min <= default <= max <= design_max; malformed rows are rejected with a typed error before guard_authority_write.
guard_authority_write(AuthorityMode::Postgres) precedes all writes to both tables; PK prefix CHECK constraints enforce 'BMA-'/'BCH-'.
scope.risk_if_missed: Morph assets without license_tag make the SMPL/Genesis tripwire (MT-488) unenforceable, and untyped track metadata collapses multi-key tracks (REQ-009/TAI-BK-033) back into single-delta scaling — the exact Daz failure that produces breast spikes at extreme dials.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
